description: A PHP class defining a base controller for an MVC framework within the Revive Adserver project, handling request processing, view management, and actions.

classes.name: OX_Admin_UI_Controller_BaseController
classes.description: A simple base controller class for handling requests, actions, views, and errors in an MVC pattern.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes translation, model, and actions.

methods.name: initModel
methods.description: Initializes the model array.

methods.name: getRegisteredActions
methods.description: Returns the list of registered actions (empty by default).

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a request by executing the specified action.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a given action if registered, otherwise raises an error.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forwards processing to another action.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect to a specified action.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the request object.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current request object.

methods.name: setView
methods.description: Sets the view object.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the current action name.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Returns the view object.

methods.name: setModelProperty
methods.description: Sets a property in the model.

methods.name: getModelProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property from the model.

methods.name: assignModelToView
methods.description: Assigns model properties to the view.

methods.name: noViewScript
methods.description: Indicates that the action has no view script.

methods.name: hasViewScript
methods.description: Checks if the view script is enabled.

methods.name: disableLayout
methods.description: Disables layout rendering.

methods.name: hasLayout
methods.description: Checks if layout is enabled.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if a value is a PEAR error or false.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the list of errors.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error message to the error list.
